statement: M11 produced 342 geography-out cross-fitted predictions across poverty unemployment and real-GRDP growth and all three target models beat the preregistered same-year peer-mean benchmark on both RMSE and MAE.
authorized_interpretation: Bounded predictive expected-performance comparison within the qualified M11 regime.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not interpret coefficients residuals or expected-performance gaps causally.

statement: M12 defines favorable empirical references for the three modeled outcomes using a primary conditional favorable-residual method and an alternative structural-neighbor favorable envelope.
authorized_interpretation: Empirical conditional reference within the qualified sample and support rules.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not call the reference a theoretical maximum or a guaranteed policy-attainable outcome.

statement: M13 contains 342 target-year-geography gap rows: 15 materially less favorable than expected 313 within the expected interval and 14 materially more favorable than expected; stronger gap interpretation is authorized for 243 rows and blocked for 99 rows.
authorized_interpretation: Descriptive and model-relative gap interpretation only where preregistered support rules authorize it.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not aggregate gaps into a monetary wasted-potential total or infer causal underperformance.

statement: The primary favorable-reference method and alternative structural-neighbor method disagree on the sign of the frontier gap in 50 rows.
authorized_interpretation: Method disagreement is an uncertainty and robustness result that must remain visible.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not average away disagreement or present a single frontier sign as uniquely identified in those rows.

statement: M14 retained one stable preregistered lagged signal: CHIRPS annual rainfall versus the unemployment adverse expected-performance gap with within-year rank association about +0.458 and geography-block permutation two-sided p about 0.0056.
authorized_interpretation: Stable non-causal association signal under the M14 design.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not label rainfall a causal unemployment driver bottleneck or policy priority.

statement: The completed 2009 West Sumatra earthquake quasi-causal study passed its core identification diagnostics but did not authorize a statistically robust directional nonzero differential-effect claim.
authorized_interpretation: Report the identification-qualified non-directional or null result as a scientific result.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not manufacture a directional treatment effect or use absence of significance as proof of no effect.

statement: M15 retains one completed quasi-causal study two not-identification-ready entries and fits zero new causal models.
authorized_interpretation: The project distinguishes identification readiness from association strength.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not upgrade M14 or other associations into causal effects without a qualified design.

statement: M17 contains seven scenario contracts including five quantitative predictive model-state sensitivities and two blocked intervention scenarios using symmetric plus-or-minus 0.5 training-fold standardized-unit perturbations.
authorized_interpretation: Predictive model-state sensitivity only; fold instability may be reported.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not interpret sensitivities as treatment effects forecasts implementable raw-unit changes or policy rankings.

statement: None of the three one-year-ahead targets poverty unemployment or real-GRDP growth beat own-lag persistence on both RMSE and MAE; zero targets qualify for substantive 2026 forecasting.
authorized_interpretation: Report forecast qualification failure and keep 2026 substantive forecasts blocked.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not publish model-generated 2026 rows as qualified forecasts or search post hoc for a better headline model.

statement: Zero of 19 current-boundary West Sumatra geographies pass the full preregistered robust monotonic CHIRPS rainfall-trend gate for 1981-2025.
authorized_interpretation: Report failure of the robust monotonic-trend claim under the locked design.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not conclude that climate has not changed; do not claim station equivalence or anthropogenic attribution.

statement: The candidate single-break rainfall regime selects 1998 in the full fit but fails predictive qualification and breakpoint-stability gates; classification is regime_shift_not_qualified.
authorized_interpretation: Report the candidate pattern and the failed qualification together.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not publish 1998 as an established climate regime shift or search another breakpoint algorithm post hoc.

statement: Expected years schooling mean years schooling and poverty fail the preregistered hierarchical trajectory benchmark requiring improvement over independent geography trends on both RMSE and MAE.
authorized_interpretation: Report model-qualification failure without denying observed descriptive change.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not issue hierarchy-based geography trajectory classifications for these indicators.

statement: Labor-force participation passes the hierarchical benchmark; 17 geography trajectories are persistent increases and none are persistent decreases under the locked robustness rule.
authorized_interpretation: Bounded modern 2018-2025 numerical trajectory classification.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not interpret as a causal labor-market improvement or guaranteed future path.

statement: Unemployment passes the hierarchical benchmark; 11 geography trajectories are persistent decreases 5 persistent increases and 3 not robust.
authorized_interpretation: Bounded modern 2018-2025 trajectory classification with direction semantics preserved.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not infer causes or extrapolate the trajectory beyond the qualified period.

statement: Real-GRDP growth narrowly passes the aggregate hierarchical benchmark but zero of 19 geography-level trajectories are robust under the locked stability rule.
authorized_interpretation: The model-level benchmark result may be reported together with the absence of robust geography classifications.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not present geography-specific structural acceleration or future growth trends.

statement: Rice yield passes the hierarchical benchmark; 10 geography trajectories are persistent increases 3 persistent decreases and 6 not robust.
authorized_interpretation: Bounded modern 2018-2025 numerical trajectory classification.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not infer agricultural policy effects climate causality or guaranteed future yield paths.

statement: M24 qualifies six BPS indicators for 32 stable-boundary current provinces over 2018-2025 producing 1536 observations and 48 provenance records while excluding six current Papua-region provinces from longitudinal backcasting.
authorized_interpretation: National comparator evidence and coverage context only.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not pool province data into district-city models or claim full-territory historical comparability.

statement: M25 qualifies 608 exact-label annual-final fiscal observations across 19 kabupaten/kota and 2018-2025 for total revenue PAD total expenditure and capital expenditure; central-transfer revenue remains held.
authorized_interpretation: Public-finance evidence context with exact source semantics and held-family visibility.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not derive unsupported fiscal ratios causal effects or monetary wasted-potential estimates.

statement: M26 materializes 57 observations across three qualified disaster-risk component classes: population exposure proxy 2020 capacity 2021 and recorded hydrometeorological occurrence context 2015-2024; observed event-level impact and undated hazard or vulnerability raster aggregation remain held.
authorized_interpretation: Component-level disaster evidence context with temporal distinctions preserved.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not synthesize a composite disaster-risk score relabel occurrence as impact or infer monetary loss.

statement: M27 qualifies 63 of 64 official BKPM quarterly investment periods from 2010-Q1 to 2025-Q4 and materializes 1440 geography-quarter-status observations; 2024-Q1 remains held because mixed duplicate mechanisms make forced deduplication indefensible.
authorized_interpretation: Bounded quarterly investment-history context with PMA PMDN and source-native currencies retained separately.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not force-deduplicate 2024-Q1 combine PMA and PMDN annualize quarters convert currencies externally rank or infer causal effects.

statement: M28 adds seven qualified BPS indicators and 931 observations to create Panel v2 with 22 indicators 2679 present observations across 152 geography-year rows and 665 explicit missing cells.
authorized_interpretation: Broader health infrastructure economic-level and demographic context under source-specific methodology regimes.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not impute aggregate indicators fit a new model claim causality rank policy or monetize gaps in M29.

statement: A definitive monetary value of West Sumatra's wasted potential is not authorized.
authorized_interpretation: The publication may state that this headline ambition remains unresolved.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not create or imply a monetary aggregate from model gaps fiscal values investment values or other evidence.

statement: The M12 favorable empirical reference is not a theoretical maximum.
authorized_interpretation: Use empirical conditional favorable reference terminology.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not use frontier language in a theoretical-production-frontier sense unless explicitly qualified as empirical.

statement: M11 predictive residuals are not causal underperformance estimates.
authorized_interpretation: Residuals support bounded predictive comparison only.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not attribute residual gaps to governance policy or any specific cause.

statement: Distance to an M12 favorable empirical reference is not a guaranteed policy gain.
authorized_interpretation: Reference distance can describe empirical separation under support rules.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not translate distance directly into intervention effect or realizable gain.

statement: The M14 rainfall-unemployment-gap association is not a causal unemployment effect.
authorized_interpretation: Association may motivate future identification work.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not claim rainfall caused the estimated unemployment gap.

statement: Recorded BNPB or DIBI occurrence counts are not observed disaster-impact outcomes.
authorized_interpretation: Keep source-native occurrence context distinct from observed impact.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not relabel occurrence aggregates as deaths damages losses or affected-population impact.

statement: A composite disaster-risk score is not authorized.
authorized_interpretation: Qualified components may be shown separately as context.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not combine temporally distinct or version-unresolved components into one risk index.

statement: M17 predictive sensitivities are not policy treatment effects and are not forecasts.
authorized_interpretation: Use model-state sensitivity language only.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not translate standardized perturbations into causal intervention gains or future predictions.

statement: Policy or cost-benefit ranking is not authorized without qualified effects costs implementation horizons feasibility and risk evidence.
authorized_interpretation: The publication may identify evidence gaps required for action readiness.
prohibited_upgrade: Do not rank interventions by attractiveness expected return or priority.
